did.unittitle: Rockefeller Brothers Fund records, Grants, Accessions 2016-2018, RG 3

physdesc.extent: 230 containers including 226 record storage boxes, Boxes 136-360, 1 large flat file folder, 1 half-letter document box and 1 letter document box.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Records ten years old and older are open for research. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Grant administration records with associated correspondence, reports, and grant products.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing may be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
